notes: Structural presentations per use and the verification rules P1–P8. P4 is the proof_valid flag per card. Pending a vetted library for draft-irtf-cfrg-bbs-signatures -12, -blind-signatures -03 and -per-verifier-linkability -03: BBS signatures, blind issuance, pseudonym computation and proof verification (P4). Pending HPKE (RFC 9180 incl. §9.8 export): sealed issuance request and response bytes. Pending Argon2id and HPKE: the backup wrap under hum/backup/1. Proofs and pseudonyms in these cases are fixed opaque bytes.
